literal: For Early Voting we have 7 centers, provisional ballots received are as follows: Atlantic City 117, Buena Vista Twp. 5, Egg Harbor Twp. 80, Galloway Twp.107, Hamitlton Twp. 53, Hammonton 39, Northfield 72.

COMMENTS FROM BOARD OF ELECTIONS: (Column K - negatives are due to Board of Elections pending voter profile updates.) Rescanning envelopes for missed barcodes when bulk scanning---no remaining Vote by Mail ballots to be counted as of 11/5
"Machines Deployed" represents the total number of tabulators, not image marking devices. Vote-by-Mail Ballots Issued updated from Election Night.

Results include all election day votes, all early votes, and timely received VBM ballots. Provisional ballots still need to be counted and investigated, however 5,323 provisional ballots were checked in on the epollbooks.
Provisionals - Early Voting and all election districts included in totals
Ballots to be processed can include signature cure and ballots to be rejected/ Deployed Machines not Included were spare machines that were not opened or used during the course of the Election

Election Day machines deployed cannot be broken down exactly by Congressional District because of split precincts in Old Bridge. The number of mail-in ballots tallied by Congressional District does not match the Municipality Totals becuse of overseas Federal ballot civilians.
Please note that Mendham Township is part of the 7th and 11th congressional districts and is broken down by voting district in order to report these numbers by congressional district.

Disclaimer: The provisional ballot numbers are unofficial and are based solely on numbers provided from our E-pollbook export. The provisional ballot report is subject to change following an official count and inventory of the actual ballots received during Early Voting and on Election Day. *There were at least 9 ballots issued with no corresponding municipality.* CC - 1 USB to be read from the City of Passaic 1-02 BOE - Overseas ballots not included
NO CHANGES EXPECTED UNTIL TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 10, 2026

There were 405 overseas ballots tallied, which are tallied by congressional district only. This explains the discrepancy between VBMs Tallied by Congessional District v. VBMs tallied by Municipality. Ballots to be processed include ontime USPS ballots and ballots deposited in the drop boxes on EDay. Total number of ballots "received in SVRS" were updated to be inclusive of rejected ballots. VBMs will be tallied on Friday, November 6, 2026 starting at 10am.
